name: Canopy Creek School
description: An open half-log schoolhouse beside a shallow creek, designed for observation, making, and muddy questions.

visual.lighting: Bright, diffuse daylight with moving leaf shadows; warm lanterns on dark rainy days.
visual.scale_notes: Mixed seating heights serve Sasquatches and smaller woodland students.

layout_rules: The chalk wall is north; broad windows face the creek to the south.
The covered experiment porch opens from the west side.
The foot-washing pump stands outside the east entrance and never dispenses footwear.
continuity_locks: School feels curious and welcoming, not strict or institutional.
Students and staff are always barefoot or have natural bare paws.
Experiments use simple, understandable materials unless an episode establishes otherwise.
